newsitem.title: UK: Coconut oil slumps late in London.
newsitem.headline: Coconut oil slumps late in London.

text.p: European vegetable oils slumped around $35 from the opening levels late on Friday.
Coconut oil had been rising all week on talk that freight for Nov shipment was in short supply but this fear suddenly appeared to evaporate.
At the start of Friday Dec/Jan coconut oil stood $5 above Thursday's finish but fell in late trade to close $25 lower.
"I think coconut oil got overheated because late in the day suddenly someone had material for Nov/Dec to sell," trader said.
At the close Nov/Dec coconut oil was offered at $765, while Dec/Jan and Jan/Feb were both offered at $735.00.
Palmkernel oil fell back with coconut oil but not as much and may have further to fall on Monday. At the close it stood unchanged to $5 firmer without trading.

The palm oil sector found little to interest it during the afternoon session and ended $2.50 firmer to $2.50 easier. Only one trade was said to occurred during the afternoon, which was for Dec crude oil at $535.
Soy oil and rape oil stayed at slightly lower levels following an easier beginning to Chicago's soybean oil futures.
At the close values on soy and rape oil were unchanged to 0.50 lower. Rape oil was thought to have traded during the afternoon at 92.50 for Dec.
